assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Reverting the multi-word prose-span branch or the exact-id linking makes tests/standard_names/test_bare_doc_link_normalize.py:201 fail on the missing [poloidal flux](name:poloidal_flux) link, as negative-control.log records with EXIT=1.
Making dry_run write would fail the readback at tests/standard_names/test_bare_doc_link_normalize.py:186, which requires the stored documentation to still equal the before text.

Reverting the tightened unit predicate makes tests/standard_names/test_docs_gates.py:465 read [10^20 m^-3], [0.1 s] and [2 GeV] as prose and fail the pass assertion, as unit-predicate-red.log records.

Removing documenting_name from review/audits.py:763 drops the self-link finding and fails test_live_documentation_audit_rejects_a_self_link, whose assertion reads the finding type and detail from the audit under test.
The action-set assertion fails unless the run happens to exercise linked, unbracketed and self-link removed together, so it guards the doc fixture as much as the code.

findings.text: non-blocking: the new _UNIT_SYMBOLS set and _UNIT_PREFIXES frozenset (doc_links.py:59) duplicate the unit vocabulary imas_codex/units/__init__.py already owns, and imas_codex/standard_names/sources/dd.py:51 states the repository's own principle of deferring to normalize_unit_symbol so no logic is re-implemented; the list duplicates rather than extends that owner and will drift from data_dictionary_unit_aliases.txt.

non-blocking: assert os.environ["IMAS_CODEX_TEST_NEO4J_EPHEMERAL"] == "1" compares the environment the fixture itself pushed through patch.dict at line 152, so it holds whatever the code under test does; the companion assert at line 167 that graph.uri equals the same fixture's disposable_neo4j has the same shape, and neither can fail on a regression.

non-blocking: test_persist_reviewed_docs_normalizes_on_accept and its sibling were rewritten onto the transaction API with forced docs_accepted and clear_holds_not_raised patches, repairing a pre-existing failure of persist_reviewed_docs, which the node did not touch and the goal does not imply; the same two failures reproduce at the base revision.

non-blocking: the numeric-interval test was moved ahead of the letter test to make it reachable, but _NUMERIC_INTERVAL_RE matches only digits, dots, commas and spaces, so the letter test immediately below returns False on exactly the same inputs and the branch still decides nothing; the brief offered removal where the earlier return already covered it.
